svg.title: Skin lesion classification: study design and training strategies
svg.desc: MILK10k clinical and dermoscopic pairs support a comparison of ResNet18 and ViT-B/32, retaining dermoscopic ViT-B/32 for eleven-class and binary classification. Five illustrated experiments cover a supervised baseline, online augmentation with class-aware repetition and sampling, class-by-skin-tone weighted loss, their combination, and multimodal contrastive pretraining followed by combined fine-tuning. A separate potential-extensions panel names diffusion-based learning, alternative transfer learning and other strategies. Real photographs are credited to the MILK study team under CC BY-NC 4.0 in assets/README.md. Matrices and sampling tokens are conceptual diagrams, not measured data.
